readsAs: a branch-and-merge path diagram (two lanes splitting and rejoining)
an eye or lens outline on a horizontal line
an electronics schematic symbol such as a fuse or inline component
judge.why: The split-and-rejoin path fits a 'seam' tool, but it is close to the familiar git branch/merge cliché, the hard vertical cuts where the orange meets the teal look unresolved, and because the shape is very wide it shrinks to a tiny horizontal blip in a square GitHub avatar at 16–32 px.
